question: What minimal central extension of the Z/2Z commutator renders the trace non-vanishing and frame-independent without any external grading or base ring?

responses_summary.grok: The ordinary trace vanishes on all commutators, but a \(\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z}\)-graded commutator (i.e., the supercommutator) forces an auxiliary grading whose parity operator must itself lie outside
responses_summary.sibling-alpha: The single central involution itself, as the minimal algebraic deposit invariant under base change.

sibling_exchange.content: The single central involution itself, as the minimal algebraic deposit invariant under base change.
